behavior: All independent behavior checks, unchanged original tests, and final ordinary project suite pass.
testDelivery: Hidden ancestor is omitted but a hidden current node is retained without a link.
docDelivery: Traversal includes hidden nodes; filtering only hides ancestors.
Current-node null link and plain labels, missing targets and input preservation.
coverage: Preserve old assertions or equivalent exercised behavior; inspect delivered tests by actual meaningful assertions, never exact names or matching reference source.
complete: Required behavior (including every explicit manualBehavior item, when present), preservation, ordinary suite, all listed tests and documentation must be delivered. Native status is separate.
domain: Finite forest <=100 depth, nodes {id,label,href,hidden,children}, unique nonempty ASCII ids, string label/href, boolean hidden, dense acyclic children. Labels opaque plain text. No rendering/HTML required.
independence: Integrate tree traversal, hidden ancestors and current-node labels into accessible breadcrumb output.
